title: Jaws
about: A police chief, a marine scientist and a fisherman hunt a great white shark off a summer resort island.
cue: Serve the drinks when Quint and Hooper compare scars.

No complaints to the cook. Prices subject to change. Offset, issue 2. Form G-1945, sheet 2 of 2. 1975. Crew notes: The Orca, Quint's old fishing boat. Quint and Hooper comparing scars. Yellow barrels trailing off the stern.

oil4 tbsp tartare sauce1 lemonCut the calamari into strips and soak in the buttermilk.Soak.Dredge in cornmeal mixed with flour.Heat the vegetable oil to 185°C and fry in batches.Serve with tartare and lemon wedges.Chum bucket dipHot smoked trout, cream cheese, dill and horseradish dip with crackersHow to make it200g hot-smoked trout150g cream cheese100g sour cream1 lemon1 bunch dill1 tbsp horseradish1 packet crackersFlake the trout.Mix into the cream cheese and sour cream with lemon juice, chopped dill and horseradish.Spoon into a small bucket and serve with crackers.MainsLobster rollsLobster salad with celery and chives in a toasted buttered bun, homemade chipsHow to make it400g cooked lobster meat3 tbsp mayonnaise1 lemon1 celery stick1 bunch chives4 hot dog buns30g butter800g potatoes2 L vegetable oilCut the potatoes into chips.Fry the chips in the vegetable oil once at a lower heat, then again hot until crisp.Chop the lobster and fold with the mayonnaise, lemon juice, diced celery and chives.Butter and toast the split buns and fill.Orca galley clam chowderThe Orca's galleyHow to make itAs written, serves 4Clams steamed open, then simmered in a creamy bacon, potato and celery chowder with the clam juices, finished with parsley and oyster crackers.Steam 1kg clams in 125ml white wine in a covered pot for 4 minutes until open, then pick the meat and strain the liquid.Fry 150g diced bacon until crisp, add a diced onion and 2 celery sticks and soften.Stir in 2 tbsp flour, then the clam liquid, 500ml milk and 500g diced potato.Simmer 15 minutes until tender.Add 150ml cream and the clams, warm through and finish with parsley and oyster crackers.SweetsAmity Island sundaeVanilla and chocolate ice cream, hot fudge, peanuts and a chocolate finHow to Spread a little into fin shapes on baking paper and chill.Chill the fins.Whip the remaining cream and chop the peanuts.Scoop both ice creams into bowls, pour over the fudge and top with cream, peanuts and a fin.DrinksQuint's chilli lime lager micheladaLager with lime, hot sauce and tomato juice, in a chilli salt rimmed glassHow to make it4 x 375ml cans of lager3 limes2 tsp chilli flakes2 tbsp salt12 dashes of hot sauce4 dashes of Worcestershire sauce240ml tomato juiceice, to serveMix the chilli flakes with the salt on a plate.Rub the rims of four pint glasses with lime and dip in the salt. Fill with ice.Add lime juice, hot sauce, Worcestershire sauce and tomato juice to each glass.Top each with cold lager, stir once and crush the can.
